name: image-block
title: image-block
description: A single image from a URL with an optional caption beneath it.

definition.name: image-block
definition.description: A single image from a URL with an optional caption beneath it.
definition.whenToUse: Show one image from a URL — a photo, screenshot, generated visual, diagram — with an optional caption under it. The plain single-image choice: no title, no action button, no multi-image swiping, so it reads as a quiet figure rather than a promo or a gallery.

image.description: The picture to show. A URL the platform can fetch.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for anyone who cannot see it.

caption.description: The line printed under the picture. Empty means no caption.
caption.default: A caption sits under the picture.
